name: IC Power Linear Regulator — LDO, 3V — MSOP
description: Cluster of 3V LDO linear power regulator ICs in surface-mount MSOP footprints, including MSOP-8 and MSOP-12-1EP packages.
selection_hints: Select for surface-mount 3V linear regulator (LDO) applications using MSOP packages.
Choose between standard MSOP-8 (3x3mm) and thermal exposed pad MSOP-12-1EP footprints.
Verify specific symbol pinout and footprint assignment for LT1762-3, LT1962-3, LT3011xMSE, or MIC5219-3.0YMM.
avoid_when: A regulated output voltage other than 3V is required.
The PCB design requires package families other than MSOP or through-hole mounting.
A switching regulator topology is required instead of a linear LDO regulator.
